meta.note: Proposed lightweight type; nothing is built. Six default columns on purpose: the type exists mainly to save related links, so the grid stays narrow. Category is the existing Wikidata category column, which already works on every content type. Page titles, sites and dates are real public pages but were not fetched by the metadata reader (it does not exist yet); categories and the 'Added' dates are illustrative. Thumbnails are not inlined (artifacts block remote images), so every row shows the type glyph where the app would show the page's og:image or favicon.
